audience: teams that keep leads, projects and tasks in Airtable bases

useCases.title: Find a base and its tables
useCases.text: List the bases the token can access. Then read the tables, fields and views of one base.

useCases.title: Filter the rows of a table
useCases.text: Read the schema of a base, then list the records of one table with a view, a formula filter and a sort.

useCases.title: Check the connection and read one record
useCases.text: Check which Airtable user the token belongs to. Then get one record by its id with its cell values.

useCases.title: Add new leads to a table
useCases.text: Create 1 to 10 records per call, with cell values keyed by field name. Created rows cannot be undone with this server.

useCases.title: Update the status of tasks
useCases.text: Update 1 to 10 records by id. Only the fields you send change, and the cell values you send overwrite the old ones.
